parameters: It's times like these I ask me'self what went wrong. How'd the likes of Stefan end up against these devil worshippers, runnin' the risk of bringin' harm to this beautiful face voluntarily?\! Ah well, these prisoners likely won't be savin' themselves.

These guards are no joke, but as a certified Thief™, I can take these guys out with a Stealth Attack.\! If I'm the one attackin', I'll be able to hit enemy squads from behind, no need to fuss with the heavily-armored front line guys.
Someone up there likes you, friend. Let's get ya out of those chains...
Name's Stefan. I'm workin' for the Temple.
Can ya swing a sword, \n[8]? Well I hope so, because these cultists are hot on my trail.\! We'd best find our way outta here, friend. I think I saw the exit around the corner, just northwest of here.
...Whoa. Stefan, how do you plan on getting by the blonde with the giant hammer?
Nah, that's Diana, our ticket outta here. She's my partner in crime!
Diana, as in, the leader of the Temple Paladins? I never thought I'd see her in the flesh.\! Why in the world would such a figure be here...
Let's have a meeting of the minds later, \n[8]. If I were you, I'd just do what I do and let Diana deal with these guys while I nab the loot.\! Works like a charm every time, heh heh.
Are you one of the prisoners here?
This is fortunate. We did not expect this. You must come with me.
Guess I'm in no position to argue...
Hell's bells, guess my cover's blown!\! We gotta get movin', kid, they're bringin' in reinforcements!

Well would ya look at that.\! We got ourselves some Treasure, ripe for the taking.\! Sure it's not part of my mission, but as a certified Thief, I would be doing a disservice to my kind to leave any Treasures behind! It's my moral duty.\! All I gotta do is walk right on top of it, and what's inside the Treasure is ours. In fact, anyone can grab it, not just me!
